prs.title: fix(compiler-dom): preserve static boolean binding semantics
prs.author: edison1105
prs.body:
fix #16051
close #15910
close #16053

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Corrected rendering of constant boolean bindings in static content: false-like values are omitted, while truthy and string values are preserved.
  * Bound boolean attributes on custom elements now retain their runtime behavior instead of being incorrectly stringified. Static boolean attributes and other eligible bindings can still be stringified.
  * Improved handling of boolean values across nested custom elements, including updates and element identity.

prs.title: fix(types): add dialog closedby attribute
prs.author: TheAlexLichter
prs.body:
Currently Vue.js is missing the [`closedBy`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLDialogElement/closedBy) property for the dialog.

This PR adds it.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added TypeScript support for the HTML `<dialog>` element’s `closedby` attribute, with accepted values `any`, `closerequest`, and `none`.
* **Tests**
  * Added checks confirming valid values are accepted and invalid or valueless usage is rejected.
